description: PROP-Q6-sentinel-rm declares mechanism 'static-analysis (AST + grep) + integration' with finite expected call-site set. No AST walker exists. No grep test exists. test_anti_human_v2.py runs anti_human_touch_violations over sources but does NOT scan for .dormant.sentinel unlink call sites. There is no automation that would fail if a developer introduced a third unlink(.dormant.sentinel) call. Verification tier (Tier 1 static-analysis) does not match what's actually executable.
